title: Derived transport with cartesian stage interfaces
statement: For the two cartesian squares and a compatible map r of their source overlaps and m of their cartesian pullbacks, construct the fixed derived transport as a natural isomorphism from derived pullback along r followed by the g-stage functor to the f-stage functor followed by derived pullback along m. The forward stage functors are exactly pullback along the inverse cartesian isomorphisms, so the data are the existing constructed derived transport with those two endpoint functors rewritten by their proved equations.

source.place: Restriction compatibility; fixed derived-pullback composition in Tag 0D5S.

proof.text: The forward stage functors are definitionally the indicated derived pullbacks. Construct perfectOverlapDerivedPullbackTransport directly at these endpoints, without inserting equality transports by rewriting the two functors. This is exactly the original fixed transport and introduces no new witness.

proof_origin.place: Fixed derived transport at the definitionally equal cartesian stage endpoints.
